verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own Hosted Payment Page, described as a secure, pre-built page hosted by Airwallex. It also offers Drop-in Elements that collect payment details, and a quickstart built on Airwallex.js. Together these imply card entry happens on Airwallex-controlled surfaces rather than the merchant's servers. However, none of the evidence explicitly mentions tokenization, PCI DSS scope reduction or SAQ eligibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of card tokenization, statements that raw card data never touches merchant servers, PCI DSS scope/SAQ guidance, independent corroboration.
